title: anotis foetida
intro: Anotis foetida, commonly known as "Fetid Anotis" or "Fetid Starflower", is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Anotis foetida include its ability to induce sweating, which helps in removing toxins from the body, and its antiseptic properties, making it effective in treating wounds and skin infections. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
